faq.question: Is Retainr really free forever?
faq.answer: Yes. Retainr is now free forever. There are no more plans, seat fees, or feature limits.

faq.question: Will the portal use my brand?
faq.answer: Yes. Your branded portal can carry your logo, brand name, custom domain, and client-facing experience.

faq.question: Can I invite my team and add unlimited clients?
faq.answer: Yes. Retainr no longer limits workspace seats, clients, buyers, or service relationships by plan.

faq.question: Does Retainr charge a transaction fee?
faq.answer: Retainr adds no percentage transaction fee. A connected payment provider may still charge its standard processing fees.

faq.question: Who owns the data, customers, and subscribers?
faq.answer: You do. Your client data, customers, orders, and subscribers belong to your business.
